in_hebrew.name: Tully
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tully הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Irish word ‘tulach’, meaning ‘hill’ or ‘towering’. In Irish folklore, Tully was a name given to those who lived on or near a high place.
